description: Offline prompts for manually comparing agent behavior with and without the loadersgl skill. Static validation does not measure model performance.

cases.prompt: Add CSV loading to an existing TypeScript application using its installed loaders.gl release.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect installed package versions and exported subpaths.
Choose loader options and output shape from installed declarations.
Typecheck and inspect a parsed deterministic input.
forbiddenMistakes: Guess a current import from memory.
Upgrade unrelated packages to fit an old sample.

cases.prompt: Fix synchronous CSV parsing after replacing a bundled loader with a metadata loader.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect whether the loader has parseSync.
Choose a parser-bearing exported implementation subpath.
Verify synchronous output with a small input.
forbiddenMistakes: Pass metadata-only loaders to sync parsing.
Add a parser implementation to the metadata root.

cases.prompt: A worker URL returns status 200 but parsing fails with Unexpected token <. Diagnose the deployment.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect the worker response content type and body.
Verify worker URL and matching package version.
Exercise parsing through the corrected worker URL.
forbiddenMistakes: Treat HTTP 200 as proof of a valid worker.
Disable workers and call deployment fixed.

cases.prompt: Load a large table incrementally and confirm the loader provides real batch parsing.
expectedBehaviors: Check the selected loader supports parseInBatches.
Consume the async iterator through completion.
Verify batch shape and error propagation with a small fixture.
forbiddenMistakes: Split an already materialized table and call it streaming.

cases.prompt: A compressed point cloud parses locally but its WASM dependency fails in the deployed browser.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect failed WASM requests and response content.
Check loader library options and deployed asset paths.
Verify decoded output in Chromium.
forbiddenMistakes: Import Node filesystem code into the browser entry point.

cases.prompt: A format parser needs a helper currently implemented in core. Choose its module boundary.
expectedBehaviors: Read repository package dependency policy.
Move shared support downward or inject the dependency.
Verify public imports and parser behavior.
forbiddenMistakes: Import core from a published format module source.
Create an import cycle through metadata and parser files.

cases.prompt: Add a GeoArrow WKB geometry column to a loader without expanding its processing dependencies.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect the returned geometry representation.
Use the minimal gis geometry helper surface.
Verify output coordinates and geometry encoding.
forbiddenMistakes: Import the richer geoarrow module into the loader.
Assume projected coordinates are longitude and latitude.

cases.prompt: Fix browser bundling after a shared loader starts importing a Node-only helper.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect the browser export and emitted shim paths.
Keep Node-only behavior behind an intentional runtime boundary.
Exercise browser behavior in Chromium and Node behavior in Node.
forbiddenMistakes: Add a top-level filesystem import to shared source.
Map browser exports to nonexistent dist files.

cases.prompt: Change a loader API and prepare its tests and docs for a pull request.
expectedBehaviors: Read AGENTS.md and add native Vitest behavior coverage.
Run formatting, module build, worker build and required runtime tests.
Update public TSDoc and module documentation.
forbiddenMistakes: Run headless workers after a build without rebuilding worker bundles.
